title: Virtuoso Autoplayer
features:
🎹 Virtuoso Autoplayer – Script Description

An automatic piano script that plays songs for you with perfect timing and accuracy. Works in any piano game, making it universal and easy to use across different experiences. Designed for hands-free performance, this script simulates key presses to play music smoothly without manual input.

🔧 Features

🤖 Fully Automatic Playing
Plays songs without you pressing any keys.

🌐 Universal Compatibility
Works in any piano game, not limited to a single experience.

🎼 Accurate Timing
Reproduces notes with consistent rhythm and precision.

🎯 Hands-Free Performance
Perfect for AFK playing or showcasing songs.

⚡ Fast & Lightweight
Runs smoothly with minimal performance impact.

🛠️ Easy to Use
Simple execution — run and let it play.
